displacement.rule: An option that is not the winner of a goal is not published when another published option removes at least as many through cars, or is not distinguishable from it on the paired comparison, and its largest all-car rise on one block is smaller by more than the noise of the two rises: the paired intervals' half widths combined, or a floor when either has none. The rule runs on the search seeds when the options are chosen and again on the confirmation seeds, whose figures are the published ones; each dropped record says which (`basis`, `seeds`). The list is not refilled. ASSUMPTION: the floor.

estimation.aggregation: Equal-weight mean of the periods within each seed, then paired by seed. Percent changes divide by the baseline mean.
estimation.maximum: The block with the largest raw increase is chosen after looking at all blocks, so its interval is not adjusted for that choice.
estimation.method: Student t interval on per-seed differences, scenario minus baseline on the same period and seed
estimation.practicalFloors: The noise band, its floor and the reduction floor are assumed dead bands for screening. They are not uncertainty intervals.
estimation.scope: Seed variability with the network, demand and model fixed. It does not cover calibration error, demand error or day-to-day variation in real traffic.

list.label: most cut-through removed
list.rule: Through cars removed, minus the light penalty for the largest all-car rise on one block.

list.label: no street closures
list.rule: The same score, among packages made only of measures that close nothing to cars: Slow Streets, one-ways, all-way stops, traffic circles, speed humps and turn bans. No modal filters or diverters.

list.label: least detour for residents
list.rule: The smallest increase in elapsed time per requested car trip with an end inside the study area, measured until completion or the run cutoff, among packages that remove at least 50% of the most removed (ASSUMPTION: the share). Ties and differences the paired comparison cannot resolve go to the larger reduction, then fewer changes.

list.label: fewest changes
list.rule: The same score, among packages of at most 2 changes.

objectives.note: Each option lists the objectives it is the best for. Detour compares the same requested car trips with at least one end in the study area. Each accrues time from its request until arrival at the destination or the run cutoff, including unserved requests. Warm-up trips are excluded. ASSUMPTION: the reduction floor, and the detour tie threshold used only when fewer than the minimum seed pairs are available.

similarity.rule: Two rechecked packages are similar when they act at the same places, or differ by at most one change and cut through cars alike on the paired comparison, or change through cars on the side-street blocks almost identically. One of each similar group is published; the others are listed on it as variants. ASSUMPTION: the thresholds.

computed.window: From t = 0 over `minutes` simulated minutes, after the initial load and settle interval: the run the app and the stored results make. Published figures come from the rechecks only; screening runs are the same run at `screenMinutes`.
